figures.notes: Panel A clearly maps all 60 unique V3 survey stars across Teff vs log distance (highlighting the d < 10 pc solar neighborhood, n = 18); Panel B shows empirical 14-line NIST RV minus reference RV across all 22 D081 stars (-110.5 to +245.3 km/s); Panel C displays the 7 single-night Keplerian orbital RV tracks (84 exposures); Panel D shows the 159-exposure HARPS + VLT ESPRESSO continuum SNR profile. Zero overlapping labels.

Panel A shows the four-generation vetting collapse from 1,552 Legacy V2 false alarms -> 410 pre-F1 -> 166 V3.2 G1 -> 143 G2 -> 99 G3 -> 84 G4 -> 21 G5 automated M-dwarf photospheric/chromospheric survivors (0 control, 0 ETI); Panel B shows per-channel attrition (T: 136->7, P: 30->14, T_DIFF: 0->0, K_PLANET: 0->0); Panel C plots per-exposure false alarms vs SNR; Panel D compares per-exposure survivor rates across D079 (2.933), D080 (0.262), and D081 (0.132).

Panel A demonstrates the Keplerian planetary-track de-Doppler gain (Channel K_PLANET alpha=1 jumping to 67.3% at 6.5 sigma/exp and 81.4% at 9 sigma/exp vs 0.0% for uncompensated stellar-frame T_DIFF alpha=0); Panel B shows Channel T & P completeness across 1,530 trials; Panel C shows spectral completeness across 3844-7465 A; Panel D shows Gate G5_V32 2D detector discrimination (100% cosmic-ray and oblique-muon rejection across 204 trials).

Panel A displays Watt-scale 8-sigma 10 m beamed CW laser upper limits across all 14 solar-neighborhood (d < 10 pc) exoplanet hosts down to 9.03 W on Proxima Centauri; Panel B shows the 153 spectral sensitivity curves across 3844-7465 A; Panel C compares T_DIFF vs K_PLANET single-night transit limits across all 7 campaigns; Panel D shows the unified 50-science-star D079+D080+D081 transmitter power landscape from 1.30 to 114.3 pc following inverse-square scaling.
